subject: PO Autopopulate Plugin + Renewal & Capacity Add-on
messages:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@sierra-motors.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff + procurement marketplace upload (API integration request)

Hi Markus,

We're kicking off Sierra's renewal for contract 2024-RWI-778 and want to automate PO ingestion into our procurement marketplace to avoid manual corrections. Two asks: 1) a completed Sierra PO template we can upload, and 2) a minimal API spec or 'autopopulate' payload that our procurement vendor can use to pre-fill fields (especially SKU mapping and unit pricing).

Key constraints: our system requires remit/bank info present or the upload is rejected, and our portal defaults Net 30 unless there's a finance exception noted in the file. Also want to add a short-term capacity bump (2-week burst) as a separate line item if pricing is available. Our fiscal cutoff to submit is 2026-07-08.

Can you confirm who on Redwood will deliver the file/spec and whether an exception note for Net 45 is possible?

Thanks,
Elaine Torres
Procurement Manager, Sierra Motors

Attachment: SIERRA_PO_TEMPLATE_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Torres <procurement@sierra-motors.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff + procurement marketplace upload (API integration request)

Elaine 94 great to hear from you and thanks for the clear constraints. We can support both options: a pre-filled XLSX and a light autopopulate API for your procurement vendor. Tentative owners and ETA: 

- Pre-filled PO (Sierra template) 94 owner: Kim Park (Revenue Ops). ETA: 2026-07-01 EOD PT.
- Autopopulate API mini-spec + example payload 94 owner: Laura Bennett (Onboarding/Solutions). ETA: 2026-07-02 AM PT.
- Finance exception note for Net 45 94 I'll coordinate and confirm by 2026-07-01.

We can include an optional surge/burst sku entry for the two-week capacity bump; Ben will confirm pricing and whether that should be a separate committed SKU or a temporary surcharge.

If that timeline works, you should be able to validate in your marketplace before your 2026-07-08 cutoff.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0136

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: procurement@sierra-motors.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Redwood autopopulate API - brief spec and examples

Elaine 94

Attached is a minimal spec to help your procurement vendor map fields. Short excerpt below; full doc in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcdE-Redwood-PO-spec

POST /v1/procure/po/autopopulate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json
Sample body (JSON): {"external_po_id":"SM-2026-778", "legal_entity":"Sierra Motors NA", "billing":{"billing_name":"Sierra Motors NA","tax_id":"12-3456789"}, "line_items":[{"sku":"dedicated-v1","qty":1,"unit_price_cents":123450}], "term_start":"2026-08-01","term_end":"2027-07-31"}

Responses: 200 + xlsx (prefilled) OR 202 + presigned_upload_url (we return a one-hour presigned PUT).

Notes: we recommend creating a scoped API key limited to procurement uploads. If your vendor needs a presigned link flow we can return a presigned URL for direct upload into our ingestion bucket.

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-po-autopopulate-spec.md (brief spec)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Torres <procurement@sierra-motors.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood autopopulate API - populated Sierra template attached

Elaine 94

Attached is the Sierra template with fields we can prefill. Highlights:
- Legal entity: Sierra Motors North America
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Term: 2026-08-01 to 2027-07-31
- Committed SKU: dedicated-v1 (1 unit) at the committed unit price (see pricing notes)
- Payment/Remit: Redwood Operating Bank, Account ending ****1234, remit@redwood.ai (populated on the payment_terms tab)

We left cost_center blank so your system can inject internal accounting codes. I92ve attached a single-line finance approval for Net 45; if your marketplace requires a formal amendment we can produce a one-page addendum.

Attachment: SIERRA_PO_TEMPLATE_v3_populated.xlsx
Attachment: finance-net45-approval.txt

Kim Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@sierra-motors.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood autopopulate API - populated Sierra template attached

Thanks Kim 94 this is very helpful. Two quick follow-ups before we run the ingestion tests: 
1) Confirm bank/remit details are in the payment section (your note indicates they are) and whether those values will be static in future populated files.
2) The finance note is sufficient for our internal reviewer to accept Net 45, but the marketplace ingestion also validates the price fields. Can your team confirm the unit_price_cents value for dedicated-v1 and whether we should expect an additional line for a two-week burst (sku: burst-dedicated-2w)?

If those are confirmed we will run mapping tests tomorrow and aim to return the validated PO for signature.

Best,
Elaine

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Torres <procurement@sierra-motors.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood autopopulate API - pricing confirmation and optional burst line

Elaine 94

Confirming pricing: dedicated-v1 unit_price_cents = 123450 (USD $1,234.50/month equivalent for the committed pool as represented on the populated template). We can add an optional temporary burst line: sku = burst-dedicated-2w, qty = 1, unit_price_cents = 246900 (USD $2,469.00) which covers a two-week surge window. That burst item will be non-committed and billed as a one-time surcharge.

I've also created a DocuSign PowerForm to expedite the PO signature once your portal returns the validated file: https://app.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=AA12345

Please confirm cost_center value (or leave blank) and we'll finalize the prefilled file and push the DocuSign link to your team.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
